description:
In this special Episode 239 we discuss various false doctrines with Scott Ritsema from Belt of Truth Ministry, including hell and everlasting torment, which is a hot topic with the recent videos made by Left Behind actor, Kirk Cameron. Walter shares how God led him in escaping these false doctrines.

Scott Ritsema - Belt of Truth:
  @scottritsema1844
